system.roleplaying: You're the best at what you do, as long as no one else sees you do it. You can always find your own path.
system.minorTwist: Now that you're separated from your team, how will you get back?
system.majorTwist: How do you alienate the rest of your team with your loner tendencies?

greenAbility.name: Principle of the Loner
greenAbility.gameText: Overcome when doing something different from the rest of your team and use your Max die. You and each of your allies gain a hero point.
